messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- INC-2026-003: webhooks delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17; the root cause was a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- Decision: webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one [decision; valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- Decision: webhooks will sign payloads with rotating keys, because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review [decision; valid 2025-10-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-22]
- Atlas noticed that webhooks's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change [observation; valid 2026-05-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-25-2]
- The handover note of 2025-06-20 wrongly recorded Ember as the owner of webhooks [valid 2025-07-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-04-webhooks-correction]
- Decision: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, because replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far [decision; valid 2026-05-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-05-04]
- Dune owns webhooks [valid 2025-07-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-04-webhooks-correction]
    earlier: Ember owns webhooks [valid 2025-06-20 to 2025-07-04; recorded by handover/2025-06-20-webhooks]
    earlier: Atlas owns webhooks [valid 2025-03-28 to 2025-06-20; recorded by handover/2025-03-28-webhooks]
    earlier: Boreal owns webhooks [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-03-28; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- The handover note of 2025-11-07 wrongly recorded Boreal as the owner of reporting [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-17-reporting-correction]
- Ember noticed that webhooks's request volume halved after the client rollout [observation; valid 2025-05-23 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-05-23]
- Webhooks deploys only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC [constraint; valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-03-17]
- Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009 [decision; valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- Decision: billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch [decision; valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- Decision: the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff, because the flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages [decision; valid 2025-02-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-20]
- The handover note of 2025-08-29 wrongly recorded Cinder as the owner of the scheduler [valid 2025-09-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction]
- Webhooks depends on the event-bus [valid 2025-01-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-17]
- Decision: reporting will read from the event-bus instead of querying the ledger directly, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs [decision; valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
- INC-2026-009: the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03; the root cause was two leaders elected during a network partition [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- Billing-api deploys only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC [constraint; valid 2025-05-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-05]
- Decision: image-resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, because storage for originals doubled in six months [decision; valid 2026-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-03]
- Ember noticed that the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump [observation; valid 2026-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-19-2]
